187.csv::355.source_text:
"シェドレアン大神殿"での問題を
解決してくれたみたいね！
アデルドナハからも、礼をいっておいてくれと
言われたよ――
187.csv::355.translated_text: Seems you've resolved the trouble at the Shadolean Great Temple! Adair Donnchadh bid me convey his thanks as well—
187.csv::355.speaker: Deryn

187.csv::356.source_text:
今は戦果の分析中だから
もうしばらく待っていてちょうだい
187.csv::356.translated_text: The battle's spoils are under analysis even now. Wait a while longer.
187.csv::356.speaker: Deryn

187.csv::357.source_text:
今回のミッションでは物凄いはたらきを
してくれたみたいね！
187.csv::357.translated_text: You've rendered prodigious service this mission, it would seem!
187.csv::357.speaker: Deryn

187.csv::358.source_text:
戦果の報酬として、シークレットアビリティが
付与されるよ
受け取ってちょうだい
187.csv::358.translated_text: As reward for your deeds, a Secret Augment is bestowed. Accept it.
187.csv::358.speaker: Deryn

187.csv::327.source_text:
何とか退けることができたようだな
さすがだ、覚者よ
187.csv::327.translated_text: It seems you have managed to repel them. As expected, Arisen.
187.csv::327.speaker: Cornelia

187.csv::328.source_text:
戦果を集計しているところだ
報酬支給はもう少し時間をくれ
187.csv::328.translated_text: I am tallying the battle results. Grant a little more time for the reward payment.
187.csv::328.speaker: Cornelia

187.csv::329.source_text:
ただいま魔物と交戦した方々の戦果を
集計しています
187.csv::329.translated_text: I'm tallying the battle gains of those who fought monsters even now.
187.csv::329.speaker: Seneka

187.csv::330.source_text: 発表まで今しばらくお待ちください
187.csv::330.translated_text: Pray wait awhile longer for the announcement.
187.csv::330.speaker: Seneka
